description: A pink bowl sits in the middle of a red surface, with a green die, a small wooden block, a green toy brick, a blue case, and a couple of small figurines nearby. The right hand moves in from the right toward the small figurine near the bottom, pinches and lifts it, carries it leftward over the bowl, and then lowers and releases it into the bowl while the right-hand object changes from being held to placed inside.
